title: Analysts Compete in Third Annual Goldman Sachs Gives Analyst Impact Fund
description: The third annual Goldman Sachs Gives Analyst Impact Fund attracted hundreds of proposal submissions from analysts across the firm. Six teams advanced to the finals, where they competed to win grants to support innovative non-profits. Learn More http://click.gs.com/juav

asr.full_text: With your help, DREV will be able to launch their new CPAP device for respiratory distress this year and initially treat 2.4 million babies. Now all of this will ultimately lead to better neonatal health outcomes for babies around the world and will make substantial progress towards achieving one of United Nations sustainable development goals of ending preventable deaths in newborns. 1.2 billion people, or 1 in 7 across the world, lack access to safe water. It should then come as no surprise to you that of the 22 people presenting today at least one has been personally affected. For each dollar you donate to charity 25 to 35 cents is spent on administration. We have this admin costs are down to just 7% on the dollar. It's 2018. We have eradicated smallpox. We have explored Mars. We have advanced in artificial intelligence. But we have been complacent about TB being under control. 20% of the grant will be used to acquire equipment and to train community health workers, while 80% would cover operating costs for you. We present you COOPERNIC an organisation that developed simple technologies with large impact on poverty reduction and then distributes them through Women Entrepreneurs. With $150,000 from the analysts impact fund we can help COOPERNIC impact 100,000 from the analyst impact fund, we can help Copernic impact 100000 unique beneficiaries. Poverty is a complex problem. Copernic, however, has shown me that sometimes it's the simplest solutions that can have the most profound impact. Homes are more than just four walls. They provide security and create the foundation for strong families and strong communities. They engender a feeling of belonging and empowerment, and, yet, one-fifth of the world's population lacks adequate shelter. Over the past three years, New Story has built nearly 1,000 homes in Haiti, Bolivia and El Salvador using traditional construction methods. While this is impressive they realised that building homes brick by brick and house by house was not a scalable solution. 3d printing is already disrupting many industries like healthcare and manufacturing New StoryStory is the only organization to apply this proven technology to the social housing sector Founded in 2015, Annie Cannons transforms survivors of human trafficking into software professionals. They provide hope, help, and economic empowerment. Most human trafficking nonprofits today help with identifying victims, the initial rescue, and temporary housing but Annie Cannon's is among the few that offers sustainable economic opportunities. With a hundred fifty thousand dollar grant from GS we can enable the new cohort of survivors to earn 1.6 million dollars in income in total this allows Annie Cannons to reinvest two hundred eighty thousand dollars back into the organization, getting them thirty percent closer to their self-sustaining goal in just twelve months. In third place, receiving a fifty thousand dollar grant is Annie Cannons. From Dallas and San Francisco. In second place, receiving $75,000 grant, is Bond E. Shams, London. I speak for the full partnership committee when I say how impressed we are with how you have applied your professional skills and commitment to teamwork and energy to bring these ideas to us. It's an impressive range of causes with innovative solutions. This commitment to community and citizenship is what distinguishes our firm. our culture, and our people.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Goldman Sachs charitable competition where analyst teams propose nonprofit projects for grant funding. The discussion concerns neonatal health, poverty, housing, and employment for trafficking survivors, and reports grants awarded to participating organizations rather than promoting financial returns to viewers. The auditorium-event visuals are consistent with these nonprofit presentations, though they do not establish every detail of the full video.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary context is general event coverage and discussion of a charitable grant competition and nonprofit initiatives, rather than a scam mechanism, financial-return offer or paid earning guidance.
